summary: Full-stack, production-ready online grocery system for a small kirana (dry grocery only) with customer mobile-friendly website and Admin ERP, supporting shared real-time inventory across online orders and offline POS billing, OTP-based auth, notifications, inventory/Excel tools, staff roles, order/delivery/refunds, dashboards, and AI-based insights.
architectural_notes: Single shared inventory ledger must be the source of truth for both online orders and offline POS to prevent stock mismatch.
Notification system must support SMS, Email, and WhatsApp channels triggered by order-status transitions and admin alert rules.
Offline billing mode must support intermittent connectivity with sync/backfill to cloud when online.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Kirana storefront logo mark in a warm market style (kirana-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Mobile hero banner illustration showing dry grocery items (rice/atta/dal/oil/snacks/soap/shampoo) in a clean flat style (hero-banner.dim_1600x600.png)
- Set of 8 category icons in matching style (categories-icons-sprite.dim_1024x1024.png)

existing_features.title: Build a mobile-first customer storefront: browse/search dry-grocery catalog, product details, add-to-cart, checkout, view order history, and track order status.

Add authentication flows for customers and staff accounts, supporting: register with mobile number or email, OTP verification, login via OTP or password, and password reset via OTP; enforce role-based access for Admin ERP staff roles (cashier, delivery boy, manager).

Implement shared inventory synchronization between online orders and offline POS sales so that stock changes in one channel are visible in the other; provide near-real-time updates in the UI via polling/refresh patterns.

Create an Admin ERP web app area with: product management (add/edit), supplier-wise stock management, min stock alert configuration, expiry tracking, damaged stock recording, and inventory list views.
Add Excel (.xlsx) import/export tools in Admin ERP for stock/products: upload an .xlsx to bulk create/update products and inventory; download current stock/export reports.

Implement Admin “Billing Mode” (phone-based POS) optimized for Android browsers: product search, quantity entry, add to bill, apply discount, select payment method (Cash/UPI), and complete sale; on completion, save the sale and deduct stock from the shared inventory.

Implement order management workflows in Admin ERP: accept/reject orders, update statuses (placed/packed/out for delivery/delivered/cancelled/refunded), assign delivery staff, track assigned orders, approve returns, and process refunds.

Add notification event logging for order status changes and key admin alerts: new order, low stock, and high value order; expose views in Admin ERP and customer order pages showing the notification history.

Create Admin dashboard analytics combining online orders and offline POS sales: online+offline sales totals, cash vs UPI breakdown, profit (based on cost vs selling price), stock alerts, top selling items, and expiry warnings.

Implement AI-style insights as on-device/back-end deterministic analytics (no external AI services): demand forecasting (e.g., moving average), reorder suggestions (based on forecast + lead time + min stock), smart pricing suggestions (rule-based), fraud/anomaly flags (e.g., unusual discounts/refunds), and dead stock alerts (no sales for N days).
Implement dark mode and light mode across customer site, Admin ERP, and Billing Mode, with a clean kirana-style UI and consistently large, touch-friendly controls.

Establish a coherent, distinct visual theme for the entire app (customer + admin + billing) with a kirana-market aesthetic (avoid blue/purple): define color palette, typography, spacing, and component usage guidelines and apply consistently.

new_feature_requests.summary: Customer website (mobile-first) for dry grocery catalog, cart, checkout, order tracking; fast UI with big buttons and dark/light mode
Customer authentication: register/login with mobile or email, OTP verification via SMS/email, OTP login or password login, password reset via OTP
Unified real-time inventory shared between online orders and offline (walk-in) sales, with reliable sync
Admin ERP: product & inventory management (add/edit products, min stock alerts, expiry/damaged tracking, supplier-wise stock)
Excel tools: import stock/products via .xlsx and export/download stock reports
Order notifications: status-change alerts to customers via SMS+Email (and WhatsApp), plus admin alerts (new order, low stock, high value order)
Offline billing / phone-based POS in Admin (“Billing Mode”) for Android: product search, qty, cash/UPI, discounts, complete sale; deduct stock, save sale, sync online
Admin order management: accept/reject, pack/dispatch statuses, assign delivery, track orders, returns approval, refunds processing
Staff roles & permissions with logins: cashier, delivery boy, manager

Admin dashboard & analytics: online+offline sales, cash vs UPI, profit, stock alerts, top sellers, expiry warnings; plus AI tools (demand forecast, reorder suggestions, smart pricing, fraud detection, dead stock alerts)

Implement core backend data models and APIs in the single Motoko actor for a dry-grocery kirana store: products (variants/units), suppliers, inventory (including min-stock threshold, expiry date, and damaged stock), customers, staff accounts with roles/permissions, carts, online orders (with status history), offline POS sales, returns, and refunds.

projectName: Online Kirana Store: Customer Website + Admin ERP + POS Billing with Shared Inventory
